tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄༅// sdom gsum kha skong gi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa rgyan gyi me tog ces bya ba bzhugs// (2) bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa gsum dang lhag pa'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor legs byas tsha zer can// sdom gsum bka' drin 'od kyi snang ba yis// bdag blo padmo'i gnyen gcig yongs 'dzin mchog /dbang phyug dpal bzang zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// mdo sngags chos kun sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes snang ba'i dmigs bu che// srid na 'gran pa'i zla gzhan ma mchis klu sgrub mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho dang*// grub pa'i zlos gar brtan g.yo'i dngos kun bde chen ye shes thig le'i ngang*// rnam rol khyab bdag rigs brgya'i mgon po bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs la 'dud// sa 'og sa steng sa bla dug can bu'i// dri kun dag byed dam chos mtho ris klung*// ris med 'gro la stsol mkhas (3) zas gtsang sras// ston mchog nyi ma'i gnyen des dge legs stsol// gzhom gzhig bral ba'i byang chub sems rdo rje// shes rab dga' mar 'khyud pa'i sug pa yis// skal bzang rna bar gsang chen nye lam gyi// sum rtsen rnga sgra rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal// rmongs pa'i lha min ye shes rdo rjes bcom// dag byed chos kyi rgyal thabs 'chi med rigs// sa skya'i 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs// skye dgu yongs kyi bla ma khyod gcig bsngags// dge legs bsod nams mi nub mthar phyin kyang*// legs bshad smra la chags pa'i ro 'dzin gyis// shes bya'i bcud myang mkhas mang rgol ba'i dbus// 'jigs bral spobs pa'i seng chen de la 'dud// chos dang chos min rnam 'byed rab dbye'i gtam// slar yang rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar ma nyams pa// (4) kha skong dpyod ldan ku mud gnyen de yi// rnam bshad legs bshad rgyan gyi me tog spel// zhes mchod brjod dang dam bca' sngon du btang nas/

'dir nges pa'i don du na rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma zhig gi ngo bor bzhugs pa gdon mi za mod/ drang ba'i don du lta grub rnam par dag pa spel ba'i phyir mdo khams go bo la steng gi yul du rnam smin gyi skye ba bzung nas bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs te/ spyir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams dang*/ bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos kyai rdor rgyud gsum gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i bka' lung man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu mtha' yas pa rnams la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rang rgyud legs par sbyangs la/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag thams cad ches cher gsal bar mdzad cing*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos sa skya pa'i mi gcig po zhes bsngags par mdzad pa/ bdag nyid chen po kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi kha skong 'di nyid ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos yin la/ 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no// dang po la/ mtshan don/ mchod brjod/ brtsam par dam bca' ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bshad bya bstan bcos 'di'i (5) mtshan ji lta bu zhe na/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir chos dbyings bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsar 'dod pa dang*/ sems bskyed rmi lam ma dang*/ phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du 'dod pa la sogs pa'i chos log mang du 'phel ba rnams/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas sdom gsum rab dbye mdzad de sun phyung zhing*/ chos dang chos min so sor phye nas bstan pa dag par gnas la/ de rjes ring zhig lon nas stong rkyang med dgag la bde gshegs snying por 'dod pa dang*/

so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can du 'dod pa dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i don gces 'dzin brje ba yin gyi/ dge sdig dang bde sdug brjer mi rung zer ba dang*/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gcig gi dbang bskur thob pas dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang bskur thob par 'dod pa la sogs pa'i chos log mang du 'phel ba rnams bstan bcos 'di nyid kyis legs par sun phyung ste/ slar yang bstan pa rnam par dag pa'i 'phro mthud pa'am/ kha bskang bas na kha skong*/ brjod bya gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa'i phyir na/ legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba zhes kyang bya'o// de skad du gzhung nyid las/ de rjes chos log 'phel ba rnams// sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs grags thob des// lung rigs 'od kyis rab bsal nas// lam bzang snang ba gsal bar mdzad// mgon po de nyid slob tshogs dang*// bcas pa zhing gzhan gshegs gyur nas// ring zhig lon nas bod yul 'dir// lung rigs man ngag dang bral ba'i// rang bzo'i chos lugs (6) du ma yis// bstan pa'i nyams len sdom gsum la// gnad kyi don rnams bshig nas ni// thos chung mgo skor mang du byung*// de dag lung dang rigs pa yis// rnam par bsal nas gnad rnams la// skal ldan ma 'khrul spyod pa'i phyir// bstan bcos chen po 'di byas so// zhes gsungs pa yin no// des na kha skong zhes pa brjod bya ma tshang ba kha skong ba'am/ rtsom 'phro kha skong ba lta bu la 'khrul bar mi bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa bshad gzhir byas/ yul gang la na rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa kun dga' bzang po yab sras la sogs pa rnams dang*/ lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'o// tshul ji ltar na gus pas so// gang zag gang gis na rtsom pa pos so// 'o na mchod par brjod pa de tsam du nges sam zhe na/ der ma zad rgyu bde gshegs snying po la yang mchod par brjod pa yin no// de yang btud ces pa bshad gzhir byas/

gang la na/ stobs sogs kyi yon tan rang bzhin lhun grub kyi tshul gyis gzhir gnas pa'i chos dbyings dang*/ chos dbyings de'i steng gi sgrib pa'i dri ma sel bar byed pa'i lam sdom pa gsum dang*/ dri bcas dri med du gnas gyur pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ bral 'bras rnam mkhyen dang*/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu gzugs sku rnams ngo bo dbyer med pa rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying po de la'o// gzhung gi tshigs bcad 'di lta bu la yang 'chad tshul gyi dbang du byas na gsum rigs te/ btud ces pa bshad gzhir bkod pa de ni/ seng ge'i lta stangs (7) kyis khyad par gyi gzhi blang ba dang*/ gang la btud/ tshul ji ltar btud/ gang gis btud/ ces khong nas dri ba gsum bkod pa ni/ sbal pa'i 'phar bas skabs don so sor phye ba dang*/ dri ba gsum po de'i lan gyi sgo nas tshig 'bru lhag ma ma lus par bshad pa ni/ rus sbal 'gros kyis gzhung don 'jebs par bshad ces pa de yin no// de skad du/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi mkhas 'jug las/ las dang byed po bya ba yis// tshig don sbrel la ngag don blang*// zhes dang*/ 'di la sgra'i bstan bcos las/ seng ge'i lta stangs kyis khyad par gyi gzhi blang*/ sbal pa'i 'phar bas skabs don so sor phye/ rus sbal 'gros kyis gzhung don 'jebs par bshad// ces 'byung bas/ de dag gi tshul dang bstun te gzhung dka' zhing rgya che ba rnams bshad par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin no// 'chad tshul gsum po 'di ni gzhung 'chad pa la shin tu mkho zhing*/ bshad pa rgyas par spro na/ gzhung chen po rnams kyi mgo mjug kun tu legs par thob pa yin no// kha cig seng ge'i lta stangs bsdus don gyi khog phub pa dang*/ sbal pa'i 'phar ba dkyus kyi sa bcad dang*/ rus sbal gyi 'gros tshig gi 'bru non pa la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ni mkhas pa'i phugs kyi bzhed pa ma yin yang*/ gnas skabs rtog dpyod zhib mos ma brtags par zad do// rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying po de gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo dbyer med yin pa'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/

'di la gzhi'i chos thams cad mtshan nyid kyi tshul gyis tshang ba dang*/ (8) lam gyi chos thams cad yon tan gyi tshul gyis tshang ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos thams cad nus mthu'i tshul gyis tshang bas na/ 'di la gzhi lam 'bras gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa'i snying po zhes kyang bya/ zhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gyi ldog pa ma lus pa tshang ba'i snying po zhes kyang bya'o// gsum pa brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba ci zhig byed pa yin zhe na/ de'i lan ni/ bshad ces pa bshad gzhir byas/ gang la brten nas bshad na/ rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dang*/ shing rta'i srol chen po gnyis la sogs pa'i tshad ldan gyi gzhung lugs dang*/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i man ngag la brten nas 'chad/ gang 'chad na/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad/ dgos pa gang gi phyir na/ blo gzu bor gnas shing rnam dpyod dang ldan pa gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du snying brtse bas bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ don gsum ngos gzung ba'i sgo nas lus mdor bstan/ lung rigs kyis rnam par dpyad pa'i sgo nas yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la/ gzhi ngos gzung*/ lam ngos gzung*/ 'bras bu ngos gzung ba dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'am dri mas rnam par dag cing shel dkar lta bu'i khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po chos can/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi yin te/ bag chags bzang ngan gyi tshon gyis bsgyur ba las gnas skabs su 'khor 'das du mar snang ba'i (9) chos dbyings nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de yang thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i gzhi'amarten byed pa yin te/ chos dbyings 'di nyid ngo ma shes pas thog mar rnam rtog bskyed/ des nyon mongs pa/ des las bsags/ de las ma dag pa 'khor ba'i phung khams skye mched rnams 'byung ba'i phyir te/

de skad du rgyud bla ma las/ de bzhin phung po khams dbang rnams// las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas// las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min// yid la byed la rtag tu gnas// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thabs kyis zin na lam dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyi gzhi yin te/ sems kyi chos dbyings dge rtsas sad pa na 'khor ba la spong 'dod dang*/ myang 'das la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa 'byung zhing*/ de las sgrub pa nyams len la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba na/ chos dbyings de nyid la stobs sogs zag med kyi yon tan dbyer med du ldan zhing*/ dbyer med kyi sku de nyid gdul bya las dag pa rnams la longs sku dang mchog gi sprul sku sogs su snang*/ ma dag pa rnams la ri bong dang rta dang seng ge ljon shing dang zam pa la sogs par yang snang ba'i phyir te/ de skad du/ rgyud bla ma las/ srid dang mya ngan 'das pa de'i// sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong ba 'di// rigs yod las yin gang phyir de// rigs med dag la med phyir ro// zhes dang*/ 'dir ni dang po chos sku (10) ste// phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku// nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin// dang po la ni tha ma gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i byang sesam kyi bslab pa gsum/ rim bzhin lcags zangs dngul gsum gyi gzugs su bkod pa'am/ dpe don du sbyar ba ni/ chos dbyings kyi steng gi sgrib pa sel bar byed pa'i lam tsam yin te/ theg pa rang rang gi ngo skal gyi sgrib pa spong nus shing*/ spyir sgrib pa mtha' dag spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ bslab pa de dag kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i gser 'gyur gyi rtsis gsang chen gyi bslab pa'i gser du bsgyur ba'i nyams len ni chos can/

dri ma sel bar byed pa'i lam gyi mchog yin te/ sgrib pa mtha' dag myur du spong bar byed pa'i gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam yin pa'i phyir/ lam gyi mchog ces pa nyan thos kyi bslab pa sogs la yang sbyar ba ni don la mi gnas so// gsum pa ni/ gnas gyur ngo bo nyid sku'i nam mkhar bral 'bras kyi yon tan rnam mkhyen gyi zla ba shar ba las gdul bya dag pa'i chu gtsang du/ longs sku dang mchog gi sprul sku gnyis ci rigs pa'i gzugs sku 'char ba ni chos can/ lam mchog de'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin te/ bla med kyi lam sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i 'bras rgyud sku bzhi po gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir gzugs sku 'char ba zhes pa dang*/ gong gi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu zhes pa gnyis don gnad gcig pa yin te/ gnas gyur nam mkhar zhes pa dang*/ gnas gyur (11) zhes pa don gcig bral 'bras kyi yon tan zla ba zhes pa dang*/ bral dang zhes pa gnyis don gcig pa'i phyir snyam kho bo sems so// des na 'dir bshad pa'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras zhes pa/ rgyud bla nas bshad pa'i rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan bzang po so gnyis la 'khrul bar mi bya'o// gzugs sku la rnam smin gyi 'bras bur brjod pa ni/ gdul bya'i don dngos su byed pa'i gnad kyis yin te/ ngag las dri bar bya'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la don gsum ste/ gzhi'i skabs/ lam gyi skabs/ 'bras bu'i skabs so// dang po la yang gsum ste/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ log rtog bye brag tu dgag gnad kyi don bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po la/ dngos smra ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi rigs la grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i bye brag gi 'dod tshul du ma yod pa yin te/ de yang mngon pa mdzod las/ ma chags 'phags rigs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bye brag tu smra bas sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa la rigs su 'dod/

mdo sde pas 'grel bshad rgyal po sras las/ mdo sde pa dag gis rigs zhes bya ba ni sems kyi sa bon nus pa yin te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ thos sogs kyi rkyen dbang la brten nas gsar du byung ba'i zag med kyi sa bon la rigs su 'dod/ sems tsam pas/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs de ni thog ma med pa nas 'ongs pa chos nyid kyis thob (12) pa skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog ma med pa nas chos nyid kyis thob pa'i skye mched drug gi khyad par/ de nyid la ming gi rnam grangs/ zag med kyi sa bon dang*/ sgrib pa spong rung dang*/ thos pa'i bag chags zhes bzhag pa de la rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod mod/ dbu ma pas gzhal na gsum po de dag gzhi dus kyi rigs mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ de dag 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ bye mdo gnyis kyi rigs zhes pa tsam las rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi tha snyad khas mi len la/ sems tsam pas skye mched drug gi khyad par la/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blang ba dang*/ chos nyid kyis thob pa gnyis su phye nas/ snga ma la rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang*/ phyi ma la rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'jog pa yin te/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' 'grel du/ nyi snang gi lung drangs pa las/ gzhan dag ni rigs ni skye mched drug gi khyad par yin no// de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blang ba dang*/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'o zhes zer ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho bo'i legs bshad do// dbu ma pa'i lugs la gnyis te/ bka' srol gnyis kyi lugs ngos gzung ba dang*/ bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dbu ma pa'i lugs 'di ni/ byams mgon dang klu sgrub gnyis char gyis sems gsal ba sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rgyun chags shing ma 'gags pa dang*/ ngo bo mtha' bzhi spros pas stong pa'i stong nyid gnyis

(13) zung du 'jug pa'i 'dus ma byas la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying por bzhed pa yin no// bzhed tshul de yang theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma las/ ji snyed pa'i ldog pa zhes bya ba sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod par sgrub tshul bshad pa yin te/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gyi ldog pa ma lus pa tshang ba'i bde gshegs snying po ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku ni 'phro phyir la sogs pa sgrub byed gsum gyis sems can gyi rgyud la yod par bsgrubs/ ngo bo dang rgyu dang 'bras bu las ldan la sogs pa rnam gzhag bcus bde gshegs snying por gtan la phab/ sangs rgyas kyi sku shin tu mtshar pa padma'i nang na yod pa sogs/ dpe dgus bde gshegs snying po glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa'i tshul bstan/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi byang chub dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dang gsum gyis mthar thug 'bras bu'i gnas tshul khyad par du bshad pa yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub byed gsum po de la dpe dgus mtshon pa'i don dgur yod pa yin te/ rdzogs sangs sku ni/ zhes pa'i sku de la dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa'i don gsum dang*/ de bzhin nyid la dpe gcig gis mtshon pa'i don gcig dang*/ rigs dpe lngas mtshon pa'i don lngar yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste// de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni// lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang so (14) sor ngos bzung na// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dri ma med pa dang*/ sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa dang*/ 'bras bu sna tshogs pa'i shun pa'i sbubs kyi snying po dang gsum gyis rim bzhin du mtshon pa'i glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings dang*/ zab mo stong nyid ston pa'i gsung rab dang*/ brjod bya sna tshogs ston pa'i gsung rab dang gsum ni dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa'i don gsum/

gser gyi gzugs kyi dpes mtshon pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi de bzhin nyid ni/ dpe gcig gis mtshon pa'i don gcig dang*/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku dang lnga ni dpe gter dang*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing dang*/ rin po che las grub pa'i sku dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ gser las grub pa'i srog chags kyi gzugs brnyan dang lngas rim pa bzhin du mtshon pa yin te/ de skad du/ rgyud bla las/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa 'o// 'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na// 'di la dpe ni mi dmigs pas// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams// 'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin// phra mo zab mo'i tshul bstan ni// sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin te// rnam pa sna tshogs tshul bstan ni// sna tshogs sbubs snying bzhin shes bya// rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang*// dge dang rnam par dag (15) pa'i phyir// de bzhin nyid 'di gser gyi ni// gzugs dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin// gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// thogs med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blang ba mchog nyid do// rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin// dang po'i sku ni dang po ste// gnyis pa yi ni phyi ma gnyis// ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa ni// rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste// rang bzhin gyis ni byas min dang*// yon tan rin chen gter yin phyir// chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir// rdzogs longs 'khor los sgyur bzhin no// rang bzhin gyis ni gzugs brnyan phyir// sprul pa gser gyi gzugs lta bu// zhes gsungs pas so// yang klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs tshogs las/

ji lta'i ldog pa bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo spros bral bshad pa yin te/ rten 'brel gyi chos thams cad mtha' bzhi spros pas stong tshul don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas gtan la phab nas spros bral stong nyid de la 'khor 'das kun gyi bya byed rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rtsa she las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pas// de phyir stong pa ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba// de la thams cad rung ba yin// zhes gsungs pas so// bstod tshogs las/ zung 'jug gi ldog pa zhes pa bde gshegs (16) snying po'i ngo bo spros bral de yang sems gsal ba dang zung du 'jug par bshad pa yin te/ rigs pas gtan la phab pa'i stong nyid de'ang ci yang med tsam gyi stong rkyang yin pa spangs nas/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sems dang zung du 'jug pa nyid kyi chos yin pa'i phyir na/ 'khor 'das kyi bya byed rung bar gsungs pa'i phyir te/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ nyon mongs dra bas g.yogs pa na// sems zhes bya bar brjod pa yin// de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na// sangs rgyas zhes ni brjod par bya// zhes dang*/ nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang*// de bzhin dri ma med par gnas// zhes gsungs pas so// deng sang phal cher lugs 'di la rgyud bla ma las/ bde gshegs snying po gsal ba'i ldog pa nas bshad/ rigs tshogs las stong pa'i ldog pa nas bshad pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni da dung kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa cung ma longs par sems te/ gzhung kha cig las/ chos can gsal ba'i ldog pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig las chos nyid stong pa'i ldog pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig las chos sku'i ldog pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig las rgyu rigs kyi sgo nas gsungs pa sogs spyir bde gshegs snying po la bshad tshul mtha' yas pa yod mod/

rgyud bla mar ni/ dpe dgu don dgu sogs kyi skabs su mtshan nyid de dag yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ gsung rab dgongs gsal las/ rgyud bla mar ni mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas bstan par shes par (17) bya'o zhes dang*/ phar phyin bka' 'grel las kyang*/ rang gi ngo bo yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ rgyud bla mar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni zhes sogs 'dren par mdzad pas so// ji snyed pa'i ldog pa bshad tshul zhes pa yang gsal ba'i ldog pa rkyang pa la zer ba ma yin gya/ི bde gshegs snying po sgrub byed gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi rgyud la yod pa de la ji snyed pa'i ldog par 'jog pa lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad yin te/ gong 'og kun tu 'byung ngo*// 'di nyid ni kho bo'i yongs 'dzin dam pa dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i gsung las thos so// ji snyed pa'i ldog pa sogs kyi bshad tshul des na/ dbu ma pa'i lugs kyi gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i 'dod tshul la/ rgyal tshab byams mgon dang*/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i klu sgrub gnyis dgongs pa mthun te/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos can gsal ba sogs mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas bstan cing*/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung las kyang chos nyid stong pa dang zung 'jug gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pas shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis char yang*/ bde gshegs snying po gsal stong zung 'jug la 'jog par bzhed pa mthun pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa la/ phar phyin theg pa nas gsungs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang*/ rdo rje theg pa nas gsungs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs gnyis so// dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung rnams las/ bde gshegs snying po la mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma bshad de/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces (18) dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/

dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med// ces dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// zhes dang*/ sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// zhes dang*/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku 'di nyid nyon mongs pa'i sbubs las ma grol bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bgyi'o// zhes chos sku la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma gsungs pas so// der ma zad mdo sde lang gshegs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa bsgrags pa sbyang bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ ji ltar zla ba skar tshogs dang*// mkha' la lhan cig gnas pa ltar// de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang*// rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig gnas// zhes dang*/ lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ ces dang*/ dpal ldan zla ba'i 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir stong pa nyid kho na la kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i sgras bstan par rig par bya'o// zhes dang*/ mdo gzhan las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste// bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de// snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras// de bzhin gshegs rnams gsung bar mdzad// ces bya ba la sogs pa'i kun gzhi'i sgra yang*/ bde gshegs snying po 'di la bzhed pa yin te/ de dag bde gshegs snying po gsal ba'i ldog pa nas bshad pa dang don gnad gcig pa'i phyir/ 'o na (19) kun gzhi'i rnam shes de dag bde gshegs snying po yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni bde gshegs snying po'i ya gyal gsal ba'i cha yin pas 'dus byas yin la/ bde gshegs snying po ni 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan du bzhed na bde gshegs snying po yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ kun gzhi'i sgra yang 'di la bzhed// ces pa yang*/

kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi sgra bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan du bzhed ces pa'i don yin te/ sems tsam pa dag bde gshegs snying po la brten nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i ched du lang gshegs dang*/ mdo gzhan las bde gshegs snying po la kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi ming 'dogs dngos su mdzad pa de las rtogs nus pas so// rang res phyogs pa kha cig rang bzhin gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i sems gsal rig la bde gshegs snying por bzhed pa yang sems tsam pa'i grub mthar lhung gi dbu ma pa'i lugs la mi 'thad de/ rab dbye las/ tshogs brgyad 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de// mdo las bde gshegs snying po ni// 'dus ma byas su gsungs phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa nas gsungs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ mtshan brjod las/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// zhes dang*/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod// ces dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong (20) stong med// bcad dang gzhig par bya ba med// bsreg par byar med gzhig med par// stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa// 'dis ni shes rab rigs pa yis// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar brjod// ces dang*/ kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// ces dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pa bde gshegs snying po la mtshan gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa yin no// khyab mtha' ni mi 'dzin te/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// zhes pa'i ye shes de la rang bzhin lhan skyes dang zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ye shes gnyis yod pa las/ snga ma bde gshegs snying po dang*/

phyi ma mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'jam dpal dang rdo rje sems dpa' la yang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum du yod pa las/ gzhi dus kyi de tsam bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa log rtog bye brag tu dgag pa la lnga ste/ dgag bya bcad pa'i med dgag snying por 'dod pa dgag pa/ snying po gnyis su phye ba la dpyad pa/ 'gro kun snying pos stong par 'dod pa dgag pa/ dag pa gnyis po 'gal bar 'dod pa dgag pa/ snying po dpyad bzod kyi bden grub tu 'dod pa dgag pa'o// dang po la phyogs snga brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dar ṭīka pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa na re/ dri bcas kyi sems la dbu ma'i rigs pas bden pa bkag tsam gyi stong rkyang med dgag bde gshegs snying po yin zhes (21) zer ro// gnyis pa ni/ stong rkyang med dgag 'di nyid chos can/ gnas lugs kyang ma yin na rang bzhin gnas rigs dang rgyu bde gshegs snying por mi 'thad de/ rtog pas dgag bya bden grub bcad tsam gyis gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ dper na thogs bcas bsal ba la nam mkha' dang*/ mgo bor 'bigs nus kyi dngos po bsal ba la rwa med ces ming du btags pa ltar ro// des na stong rkyang 'di la 'khor ba tshang tshul dang*/ lam bsgom tshul dang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'byung tshul rtsir med pas/ ngan rtog gi drwa ba 'di dor cig ces gdams so// gsal ba dang zung du 'jug pa'i chos dbyings stong pa nyid la ni de dag rtsir yod pas 'khor 'das kyi gzhir gyur pa'i snying por 'jog pa yin te/ gzhi'i dus su 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ lam gyi dus su lam gyi chos thams cad dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus su 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyang zung 'jug gi chos dbyings de la brten pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa snying po gnyis su phye ba la dpyad pa gnyis te/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ dgongs pa ngos gzung ba'o// dang po ni/

rong ṭīka gi dngos bstan la zhen pa kha cig sems kyi stong cha dang gsal cha gnyis/ rim bzhin 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te/ ṭī ka las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// gnyis pa ni/ rong ṭīka gi dgongs pa 'di ltar yin te/ deng sang phar cher chos can gsal ba'i steng gi bden pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod pa la/ de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin na/ chos (22) can gsal ba yang rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i thal ba 'phangs pa'i sgo nas phugs kyi bzhed pa bde gshegs snying po gsal stong zung 'jug tu sgrub pa'i phyir gnas skabs su sba smyug g.yas phyogs la gug pa/ g.yon phyogs la gzhu ltar 'then pa 'khyog po bsrang ba'i tshul yin te/ gsal stong zung 'jug la ya gyal gsal ba dang stong pa gnyis ka tshogs dgos pa'i phyir/ gnad kyi don ni/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin na/ 'dus byas yin pas khyab pa sems tsam pa'i lugs dang*/ de yin na 'dus ma byas yin pas khyab pa dbu ma pa'i lugs yin pa'i rnam dbye so sor phyed dgos te/ sems tsam pas/ rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ zag med kyi ye shes kyi rgyu don gcig par 'dod pa la/ dbu ma pas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi ma nges pa brjod nas rang lugs rang bzhin de dang chos dbyings don gcig par mdzad pas na/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang chos dbyings kyi rigs don gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de skad du/ nyi snang las/ de dag gis ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la rang bzhin du brjod pa'i don brjod dgos so// rgyu'i rnam grangs yin no zhe na/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blang ba yang de yin pa des na don gyi khyad par ci yod/ chos nyid kyi rnam grangs yin pa la ni nyes pa 'di med do// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa 'gro kun snying pos stong pa dgag pa la gnyis te/
phyogs snga brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi bzhed pa la/ bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod kyi sems can

(23) gyi rgyud la med de/ dper na bu ram gyi snying po bu ram kho na la yod pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi snying po rang rang kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ mdo bstan bcos rnams las/ sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod par gsungs pa ni drang don yin te/ rab dbye las/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don dgongs pa can du gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ zhes sgro 'dogs par byed do// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lung rigs kyi gnod byed bstan pa/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs par mi 'thad pa/ ma 'khrul pa'i gdams pa sbyin pa'o// dang po ni/ paṇa chen gyi bzhed pa de ni/ 'jig rten bstan bcos gnyis ka'i tha snyad dang 'gal te/ 'jig rten dang 'gal tshul ni/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po tsandan la yod pa dang*/ mar 'o ma'i snying po yin pa sogs kyi 'jig rten gyi grags pa mi 'thad par thal/ sbrul gyi snying po sbrul kho na dang mar gyi snying po mar kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ bstan bcos dang 'gal tshul ni/ mdo las/ bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab// ces dang*/ rgyud bla las/ lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'gro ba'i rgyud la bde gshegs snying po med pa'i phyir/ de ltar gsungs pa de nyid drang don yin pa'i phyir med do snyam na/ brjod bya bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas drang nges rnam gzhag byed pa'i tshe drang don kun tha snyad du med par khas len na/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ snod bcud chags 'jig sogs kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam (24) gzhag kun chos can/ tha snyad du yang med par 'gyur te/ drang don yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ shar gyi ri bo'i sde pa dang mthun pa'i mdo las/ phung po dag dang khams rnams dang*// skye mched rang bzhin gcig bzhed la// khams gsum po dag ston mdzad la// 'di ni 'jig rten mthun 'jug yin// zhes sogs 'jig rten mthun 'jug drug gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs par mi 'thad pa ni/

rab dbye las/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi// zhes sogs dang*/ sems ni rang gnas sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo spros bral yin pa'i phyir na/ de nyid thabs kyis zin ma zin las/ sems can rnams la 'khor 'das gnyis ka 'byung*/ zhes pa lung dang po'i don dang*/ 'khor ba la spong 'dod dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa 'byung ba ni/ bya tshang du snyegs pa bzhin sems rang gi gnas su snyegs pa'i phyir bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i sgrub byed du 'thad de/ me yod pa'i sgrub byed du tsha ba yod pa ltar ro// zhes pa ni/ lung gnyis pa'i don yin cing*/ de dag dang khyed kyi 'dod pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang rab dbye las/ gal te bem po'i chos kyi dbyings// zhes sogs kyi don/ bem po'i chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po ma yin la/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa ma yin te/ chos dbyings la snying po yin min gyi dbye (25) ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas kyang khyod la gnod de/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi chos dbyings gnyis la bde gshegs snying po yin min gyi khyad par med de/ chos dbyings la snying po yin min gyi dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rigs pa kun tu mtshungs pas so// des na rang gi grub mtha' ngan pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gzhung gi don du 'chad pa ni/ 'jig rten na rang gis mi gtsang ba zos pa'i mchu padmo'i tshal la bsgo ba dang tshul mtshungs shing*/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gzhung 'khyog po'i lam du 'dren pa mtshar che bas spang dgos so zhes gdams so// gsum pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyi gzhung gi dgongs pa kho bos tshul bzhin du bshad par bya'o zhes dam bcas nas/ tshul ji ltar na/ chos dbyings dang bde gshegs snying po dang stong nyid la sogs pa ni nges don yin gyi drang don min te/

don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang padma ngan pa'i nang na sangs rgyas kyi sku yod pa dang*/ gos hrul gyi nang na rin chen las grub pa'i rgyal ba'i sku yod pa sogs dpe dgus bstan pa ltar/ bde gshegs snying po 'gro ba'i rgyud la rten dang brten pa'i tshul lam/ sgrub byed kyi tshul gyis yod pa ni drang don yin gyi nges don ma yin te/ kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rab dbye las/ 'on kyang mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang*// theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar// gos hrul nang na rin chen ltar// sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi// snying po yod par gsungs pa ni// dgongs pa yin par shes par bya// zhes gsungs (26) pas so// dgongs gzhi mtha' bzhi spros bral gyi stong nyid yin pa dang*/ dgos pa sems zhum pa la sogs pa skyon lnga spong ba'i ched du gsungs pa yang sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa la 'thad pa yin te/ de dag sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa'i dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na dngos la gnod byed yang sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa la 'chad dam zhe na/ sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod pa tsam la dngos la gnod byed med la/ sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa de nges don yin pa'am/ don dam du sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa la dngos la gnod byed 'byung ste/ nges don yin na/ kun rdzob bden pa don dam bden par thal ba'i skyon gnas shing*/ don dam du yod na mu stegs pas kun brtags kyi bdag 'dod pa dang mtshungs pa dang*/ bden par grub par thal ba dang*/ nges don gyi mdo sde las chos thams cad bden stong du bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i skyon gsum 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de skad du/ rab dbye las/ de yi dgongs gzhi stong nyid yin// dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs// dngos la gnod byed tshad ma ni// de 'dra'i bde gshegs khams yod na// mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs pa dang*// bden pa'i dngos por 'gyur phyir dang*// nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde dang*// rnam pa kun tu 'gal phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa yin no// lugs 'di la dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa 'chad pa'i gzhi bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa dang*/

dngos la gnod byed 'chad pa'i gzhi don dam du bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa la 'jog pas gzhi so sor nges pa ni gnad kyi don yin te/ (27) 'jug pa dka' 'grel las/ dngos la gnod byed tha snyad du sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa la mi 'chad cing*/ don dam du yod na mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mtshungs pa sogs sa skya paṇḍi tas gsal bar gsungs pa ni nges don gyi mdo sde dang bstan bcos dri ma med pa'i dgongs pa'o// zhes bshad pas so// sgrub pa'i tshul gyis zhes pa yang sgrub byed kyi tshul gyis zhes pa'i don yin par kho bos sems so// bde gshegs snying po nges don dang*/ sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa drang don yin pa 'di nyid ni shes byed kyi lung gis grub ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'gro ba'i sems rgyud gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis kyi spros pa zhi bar mthong ba la/ ji lta ba mthong ba dang*/ yul gyi gnas lugs mkhyen pa'i blos spros bral gyi chos nyid sems can gyi rgyud la yod par mthong ba la/ ji snyed pa mthong bar gsungs pa rtogs na gnad 'di 'bad med du 'grub pa'i phyir te/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du// rtogs phyir ji ltar nyid de yang*// rang bzhin gyis ni yongs dag phyir// nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro// shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos// thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni// sems can thams cad la yod par// mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid// ces gsungs pas so// kha cig bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod pa drang don yin pa la rnam dpyad cher med gsungs kyang*/ 'di ni rgyud bla ma'i lung des mngon sum du grub cing*/ bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa yang yin te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs (28) rgyas 'phrin zhu las// khyed kyi bde gshegs snying po'i sgra// kha cig nges pa'i don du 'chad// bdag gis drang ba'i don du ni// lung dang rigs pas sgrub te bshad// ces dang*/

rab dbye las/ sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi// snying po yod par gsungs pa ni// dgongs pa yin par shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa rnams go don gcig tu bsgrigs nas 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa dag pa gnyis po 'gal bar 'dod pa dgag pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid pa kha cig glo bur dri bral gyi chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings ma yin te/ de gnyis phan tshun spang 'gal yin pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'gal bar 'dod pa smad pa/ 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan dgag pa/ mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de smra kha'i sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ dag cha gnyis po sogs so// gsum pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi chos dbyings bstod pa las/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs pa dang*/ sngon gyi mkhas pa kun mkhyen g.yag pa la sogs pas kyang*/ chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa la/ lam nyams su blangs pas glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i tshe dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings zhes gsungs pa tshad mar byas nas/ chos dbyings yin na/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings yin pas khyab pa shes par bya ste/ rang bzhin gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dbyings gang zhig thabs kyis sbyang ma shes na srid pa gsum (29) du 'khor ba'i rgyu byed la/ rten gyi gang zag sems can gyi rgyud la gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud la/ chos dbyings gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa rang bzhin gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa de nyid lam gyis sbyangs pa byas pa las glo bur gyi dri mas dag pa'i tshe dag pa gnyis ldan de mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ chos kyi sku yang yin no zhes pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi lung de'i don yin pas so// lnga pa snying po bden grub tu 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis te/

phyogs snga brjod pa dang*/ de la dpyad pa bya ba'o// dang po ni/ mkhyen rab kyi gshog yangs phul du phyin pa rgyas pas gsung rab kyi mkha' la lang ling du bgrod kyang*/ rnam rig bag chags kyis bsgribs te mtha' bral dbu ma'i gnad ma gzigs pa'i skyes chen jo nang pa chen pos grub pa'i mtha' 'di skad gsungs so// ji ltar zhe na/ gzhi'i gnas tshul/ 'bras bu thob tshul/ rang stong gzhan stong gi khyad par/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi don/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs par bstan pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ shes bya kun la sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ don dam chos sku sogs so// gsum pa ni/ don dam kun rdzob sogs so// bzhi pa ni/ don dam 'di ni sogs so// lnga pa ni/ dpal phreng myang 'das sogs so// gnyis pa dpyad pa bya ba la gsum ste/ dpyad par dam bca' ba/ dpyad pa dngos dang*/ dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ 'di la zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa (30) mthun pa blang byar bstan pa/ lhag ma tha snyad don dam dang 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ gzhi 'bras kun tu yon tan gyi ldog pa dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po yin pa dang*/ chos dbyings de nyid stobs sogs kyi yon tan rang bzhin lhun grub kyi don dam pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa ni kho bo'ang 'dod de/ de ltar yin pa theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ mdo rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad la// khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa// zhes dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang*// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes dang*/ rje btsun mchog gis/ rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste// mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas gyur yin// des na lhun grub gnas gyur mi 'gal te// zhes gsungs pa yang*/

mdo rgyud kyi nges gsang gsal bar ston pa la rdo rje'i tshig lta bu yin pas so/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang*// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// zhes pa gnyis kyi gzhi ni rgyu bde gshegs snying po la ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin te/ rgyu bde gshegs snying po la da lta ma dag pa sems can gyi gnas skabs su dri ma 'bral rung gi tshul du ldan/ dag pa sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe na stobs sogs kyi yon tan 'bral mi rung gi tshul gyis ldan pas/ phyis sangs rgyas pa na yang sngar gyi bde gshegs snying po la ngo bo 'gyur ba med ces pa'i don yin pas so// de skad du/ thogs med 'grel chen las/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ ma dag pa dang*/ (31) dag pa'i gnas skabs na nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dag glo bur ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs rnam par dbye ba med cing bral mi shes shing*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang rang bzhin nyid kyis ldan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams nam mkha' bzhin du snga ma dang phyi mar gtan 'gyur ba med par bstan to// zhes gsungs pa yin no// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan gyi gzhi de 'bras dus kyi chos sku la 'chad dgos te/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs na/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ dogs pa 'byung mod/ 'on kyang*/ brtag pa mthar bzung la 'chad dgos so// gzhan du na// rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gi khams stong gi /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i stong mi stong gi gzhi yang khams bde gshegs snying po gcig nyid ma yin par 'gyur bas ha cang thal lo// gnad kyi don ni/ dri ma gnyen pos bcom pa'i tshe glo bur gyi dri mas khams bde gshegs snying po stong ste/

de gnyis 'bru dang 'bru'i shun pa ltar 'bral rung ba'i tshul du yod pa'i phyir/ khams bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas su gnas gyur pa na stobs sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus rtag tu mi stong ste/ de'i tshe yon tan de dag dbyer med du ldan pas ye 'bral du mi rung ba'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// zhes sogs kyi don du 'chad shes na gong gi de yang (32) 'khrul med du go bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa tha snyad don dam dang 'gal ba la/ gzhi 'bras kyi 'dod tshul tha snyad dang 'gal ba/ gnas lugs kyi 'dod tshul don dam dang 'gal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gzhi'i 'dod tshul tha snyad dang 'gal ba/ 'bras bu thob tshul rigs pa dang 'gal ba'o// dang po ni/ jo nang pa'i bzhed pa lhag ma tha snyad don dam dang 'gal ba 'og nas 'byung ba 'di ltar mthong ngo*// de yang tha snyad dang 'gal ba'i tshul la/ dri bcas sangs rgyas yin pa la gnod byed bstan pa/ mtshan btags phye ba gnad du gces par bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dri bcas kyi chos dbyings sangs rgyas yin na/ tha snyad dang 'gal bas gnod de/ de ltar na tha snyad kyi tshe dman mnyam sogs kyi khyad par med par 'gyur ba las tha snyad kyi tshe de dag so sor phye nas smra dgos pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ stong nyid bdun cu pa las/ gnas pa'am skye 'jig yod med dam// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung gsungs la/ de'i go don yang skye gnas 'jig gsum dang*/ yod med dang dman 'bring mchog gsum gyi rnam gzhag tha snyad du khas len la/ don dam du khas mi len zhes pa'o// de ltar byas pa la kho na re/ tha snyad kyi tshe na de ltar khas len dgos mod/ spyir tha snyad tshad mar byas na gang zag la mi rton chos la rton pa dang*/ tshig la mi rton don la rton pa dang*/ drang don la mi rton nges don la rton pa dang*/ rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa dang bzhi'i go rim bzlog par 'gyur te/
chos la mi rton gang

(33) zag la rton pa sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir zhe na skyon med de/ de'i go rim thog mar tha snyad khas blangs tshar nas phyis nas don dam gnas lugs la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi go rim yin gyis/ spyir tha snyad dang po nyid nas dor na tha snyad gsungs pa don med du 'gyur ba'am/ go rim log par khyod la 'gyur te tha snyad ye khas ma blangs par don dam la zhugs pa'i phyir/ don dam rtogs pa'i rten du thog mar tha snyad khas len pa ni klu sgrub kyi lung gnyis dang*/ 'jug pa'i lung gis grub pa yin te/ tha snyad khas ma blangs par don dam mi 'chad ces pa ni rtsod zlog gi lung gi don dang*/ thog mar tha snyad la ma brten par don dam bstan par mi nus shing*/ don dam ma rtogs par 'bras bu myang 'das mi thob ces pa ni/ rtsa she'i lung gi don dang*/ tha snyad bden pa thabs dang*/ don dam bden pa rtogs pa thabs byung yin pa'i rnam dbye mi shes pa ni rnam rtog log pa'i rab rib kyis bslad pas lam ngan pa la zhugs so zhes pa ni/ 'jug pa las/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang*// don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa ste// de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis mi shes pa// de ni rnam rtog log pas lam ngan zhugs// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin pas so// gal te kho na re/ tha snyad kyi tshe na yang dri bcas kyi chos dbyings sangs rgyas yin pas bshad ma thag pa'i skyon med do zhe na/ 'di dgag pa la/ 'phags pa byams pa'i gzhung dang 'gal ba/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung dang 'gal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal te/ (34) sems kyi chos dbyings mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis kas ma dag pa la sems can dang*/ mthong spang gis dag sgom spang gis ma dag pa la byang sems 'phags pa dang*/ gnyis kas dag pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jog pa ni lung de'i don yin zhing*/

de dang tha snyad kyi tshe dri bcas kyi chos dbyings sangs rgyas su 'dod pa gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar sos ka'i dus su chu// zhes sogs dang*/ ji ltar sbun pas g.yogs pa na// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal ba yin te/ dpe dpyid dus su chu dro zhes dang*/ dgun gyi dus su chu grang zhes brjod pa bzhin du/ sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa'i tshe na sems can zhes dang*/ de dang bral ba na sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa yin no zhes pa ni lung dang po'i don dang*/ dpe phyi rol gyi sbun pas g.yogs pa na nang gi so ba 'bras bur mi 'dod/ de dang bral ba na 'bras bur 'dod pa bzhin/ sgrib pa dang bcas pa na sems kyi chos dbyings la sems can zhes brjod/ sgrib pa dang bral ba na sangs rgyas su brjod pa yin zhes pa ni lung gnyis pa'i don yin zhing*/ de dang khyed kyi 'dod pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mtshan btags phye ba la bzhi ste/ mtshan btags phye ba dpe dang bcas te bstan/ dpe la mtshan btags mi phye lung rigs 'gal/ don la mtshan btags mi phye gzhung dang 'gal/ des na 'khrul med grub mtha' blang byar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dpal ldan rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ kyai rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan gyis 'bras rgyud dngos su bstan nas/ rgyu rgyud dang thabs (35) rgyud shugs la bstan pa shes pa'i mthun pa'i dper/ phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus las/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs// bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi// gzhung dang lam la'ang de sgra yin// zhes gsungs pa bkod pa 'di gus pas longs shig ste/ de blangs pas gzhi dus kyi chos yin na sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i khyab pa shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ spyi rnam gyi lung dngos ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang shes rab chen po zung du 'jug pas na/

kyai rdo rje 'bras bu'i rgyud do// de lta bu'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i lam la'ang kyai rdo rje/ rgyu yang kyai rdo rje yin dgos pas rgyud gsum ka kyai rdo rje ste/ phyogs kyi glang pos/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ces sogs drangs nas zhes bshad pa lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pa 'di yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ rang phyogs kyi bla ma kha cig na re/ spyi rnam 'di las rgyud gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid par bzhed pa yin te/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis char gyis rgyud gsum ka kyai rdo rje zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin pa mi 'thad de/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi mtshan don bshad pa'i tshe rgyu lam gnyis la'ang thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas kyai rdor gyi mtshan don bshad du yod pas/ gsum ka brjod bya don gyis kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin kyang*/ mtshan btags phye ba'i tshe/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid// badzra'ang shes rab brjod par bya// zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi kyai rdo rje de kyai rdor mtshan (36) nyid pa yin la/ gzhung de'i shugs las bstan pa/ rgyu lam gyi kye rdor gnyis ni kye rdor btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir/ sku mched kyi lung gi don ni/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud// de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon// ces pa'i don/ thabs shes zung 'jug de rgyud gsum ka la bshad du'am/ 'chad du yod pas na/ rgyu dang lam la'ang dngos btags ma phye ba'i kye rdor gyi sgra 'jug tu yod pa'i phyir/ rgyu rgyud kyi kye rdo rje sogs gsum 'chad pa la kye rdor 'chad ces pa tsam gyi don no// yang na rgyud gsum ka mtshan don gyi skabs kyi kyai rdo rje'am/ dngos btags ma phye ba'i skabs kyi kyai rdo rje yin zhes pa'i don te/ zab don bdud rtsi spel bar yang de ltar du bshad do// kye rdor mtshan nyid pa la lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can dang*/

thabs shes dbyer med kyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gnyis las/ snga ma ni gang zag yin pas/ rgyud gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu kyai rdo rje ma yin la/ phyi ma de/ he ni snying rje zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis dngos bstan dang don gcig pas/ rgyud gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu kyai rdo rje mtshan nyid pa yin no// gal te rgyud gsum ka kye rdor mtshan nyid pa yin na kye rdor gyi sgras 'bras rgyud dngos su bstan nas/ rgyu lam shugs la bstan pa mi 'thad de/ gsum ka kye rdor mtshan nyid par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa zhes pa'i sgras/ gser bum dngos su bstan nas/ dngul bum dang zangs bum shugs la bstan pa mi 'thad pa bzhin no// gsum pa don la mtshan btags mi phye gzhung dang 'gal ba la/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung dang 'gal ba/ rang gi bod gzhung nyid dang (37) 'gal ba/ de'i dgongs pa'ang dpyad du yod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhung lam gyi sher phyin gnyis sher phyin mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa des na/ seng ge bzang po'i brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu ni dngos yin la/ de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyi tshig dang ngag gi tshogs kyi gzhung dang*/ mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lam la yang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni btags pa'o// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi 'grel pa las kyang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgra'i don ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gtso bo dang phal pa'o// zhes gsungs pa gnyis ni don gnad gcig pa yin te/ dngos dang gtso bo don gcig btags pa ba dang phal pa don gcig pa gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyi lugs yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar don gcig pa rnam 'grel las/ ji ltar grags las grub gang yin// zhes sogs kyis bstan pa yin te/

ming ji ltar grags pa las grub pa gang yin pa de ni dngos dang*/ dngos de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir gang la ming de skad brjod pa ni phal pa ste/ kha che sna nyag la seng ge zhes pa lta bu dngos la ming gzhan dngos med btags pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni gzhung de'i don yin pas so// gnyis pa bod gzhung dang 'gal ba ni/ gzhung lam sher phyin sogs so// gsum pa dgos pa dpyad du yod pa ni/ nges don rgya mtsho las/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes spyi tsam pa sher phyin mtshan nyid par gsungs pa de yang mi 'thad de/ gzhi dus kyi gzhi 'bras dbyer (38) med kyi gnyis med ye shes sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin na/ brgyad stong don bsdus sogs las/ de bzhin gshegs pa sher phyin mtshan nyid pa'i rten gyi khyad par du gsungs pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin gshegs pa la/ gzhi dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs mang du yod pa las/ gzhi dus kyi de gzhi dus kyi gnyis med ye shes kyi rten yin pas skyon med do snyam na/ mi 'thad de/ gzhi dus su de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan nyid pa yod pa la tha snyad dang 'gal ba'i skyon lngar bstan zin pa'i phyir/ skyon gzhan yang gzhung lam gnyis la mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba'i yongs grub sher phyin mtshan nyid pa ma yin na/ chos thams cad la mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba'i yongs grub sher phyin mtshan nyid par khas blangs pa'i jo nang pa rang gi grub mtha' dang 'gal/ yin na shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis zhes sogs gzhung 'di'i don brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs las sher phyin la dngos btags phye ba'i rgyab brten du drangs te bshad pa dang 'gal lo// bzhi pa 'khrul med blang byar bstan pa ni/ sher phyin la dngos btags phye dgos pa des na/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis zhes sogs gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa ni/ seng ge bzang po la sogs pa'i 'phags yul mkhas grub kun mthun par/

sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i spyi rnam sogs las tshul bzhin bshad pa gus pas longs shig ces gdams so// gnyis pa 'bras bu'i 'dod tshul rigs pa dang 'gal ba ni/ chos sku glo bur sogs so// gnyis pa gnas lugs kyi 'dod tshul don dam dang 'gal ba la bzhi ste/ nges don gyi gzhung dang 'gal ba/ dngos smra 'gog pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal ba/ mdo sde snga phyi'i dogs (39) spong dang 'gal ba/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs par mi 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ chos dbyings bden grub tu 'dod pa ni don dam sgro 'dogs kyi mthar lhung bas gnas lugs ston pa'i nges don gyi lung rnams dang 'gal te/ mdo las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// zhes zab pa sogs lnga ming gi rnam grangs du gsungs pas/ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas bden med du bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ rtsa she'i 'dus byas brtag pa'i rab byed las/ skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dag /ces sogs gsungs pas kyang skye gnas 'jig gsum bden par ma grub pa'i phyir na 'dus byas bden par ma grub la/ de bden par ma grub pas 'dus ma byas kyang bden par ma grub bo zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang klu sgrub kyi/ dngos po yod pa ma yin na// dngos med gang gis yin par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ skye ba la sogs med pa'i phyir// skye ba med la sogs mi srid// ces gsungs pa yang 'dus byas brtag pa'i de dang don gcig pa yin te/ dngos po dang skye ba bden par ma grub pas de la ltos pa'i dngos med dang skye med yang ma grub par bstan pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bshad pa la/ dngos smra bas chos thams cad rang bzhin med ces pa'i tshig de yang rang bzhin yod dam med/ med na rang bzhin med pa'i dam bca' nyams/ yod na rang bzhin grub pa'i chos zhig khas len dgos par 'gyur ro zhes sogs kyi rtsod pa 'gog pa'i rtsod zlog gi rigs pa rnams dbu ma pa rang la bzlog par 'gyur te/

bden grub dam bcas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtsod zlog las/ (40) gal te ngas dam bcas 'ga' yod// ces sogs gsung zhing*/ de'i dam bca'i don bden grub kyi dam bca' la khyed rang yang 'chad pa'i phyir/ nga la dam bca' med pas na// zhes pa'i don gtso bo rang bzhin med par dam bca' ba med pa la 'chad dgos pa yin te/ dngos smra bas/ khyod kyi dam bca'i mtshan nyid la// de ltar skyon yod nged la min// zhes rtsod pa de'i lan gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang de kho na la 'khrul par mi bya ste/ tshig gsal las/ phyogs gzhan khas blang ba med pa'i phyir zhes dang*/ de'i rgyab brten du gal te/ ngas dam zhes sogs dang*/ 'phags pa lhas/ yod dang med dang yod med ces// gang la phyogs ni yod min pa// de la yun ni ring po na'ang*// klan ka brjod par nus ma yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams 'dren par mdzad pas/ spyir dbu ma pas don dam par bden par yod med dang gnyis ka la sogs pa'i dam bca' gang yang khas mi len pas/ rgol ba gzhan gyis rtsod pa'i skyon dang klan ka ci yang med ces pa yang gzhung 'di'i don du 'chad dgos so// gnad kyi don ni/ don dam par rtsod pa las grol bas bsgrub bya bden med bsgrub par dam bca' rgyu yang med/ phyogs gzhan dgag bya bden grub 'gog par dam bca' rgyu yang med pas gnas lugs la dpyod pa'i tshe rang rgyud pa'i gtan tshigs mi 'thad ces pa ni thal 'gyur ba'i grub pa'i mtha' yin te/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ rtsod med che ba'i bdag nyid can// de dag la ni phyogs nyid med// gang la phyogs ni yod min pa// de la gzhan phyogs ga la yod// ces dang*/ (41) 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ dbu ma pa yin na rang gi rgyud kyi rjes su dpag par bya ba rigs pa ma yin te/ phyogs gzhan khas blang ba med pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas so// gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag byed pa thams cad ni kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rnam rol du khas len pa yin te/

ji ltar sprul pas sprul pa dang*// sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i sgyu ma la// dgag pa byed pa ci 'dra ba// dgag pa de yang de 'drar 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnod byed de ltar 'phangs pa la jo nang pa'i rjes 'brang kha cig na re/ skyon med de/ 'dus ma byas bden par ma grub par bshad pa dang*/ bden grub kyi dam bca' med par bshad pa ni 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi gzigs ngor yin gyi/ rjes thob tu yod med dang yin min shan 'byed pa'i skabs ma yin pa'i phyir zhes zer ro// de yang mi 'thad de/ snga ma de gdul byas gnas lugs rtogs pa'i don du rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ phyi ma de dbu ma pas dngos smra ba'i rtsod pa bzlog pa'i skabs yin zhing*/ skabs de gnyis mnyam gzhag gi skabs yin zhes smra ba ha cang thal ba'i phyir/ des na rjes thob tu rtsod pa mi byed par mnyam gzhag tu rtsod pa byed ces smra dgos pa 'di ni chos can/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' ngan pa la lung rigs kyi gnod byed byung ba na tshugs ma thub pa'i rang ldog yin te/ bdag nyid chen pos/ shel la nor bu'i kha bsgyur yang*// chu dang 'phrad na rang mdog ston// zhes bka' bstsal pa bzhin no// gsum pa dogs spong dang

(42) 'gal ba ni/ snying po bden grub tu 'dod pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der// shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes// gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la// sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs// sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*// yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur// bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la// yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs// zhes bshad pa dang 'gal te/ de'i don bshad na/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ sprin rmi lam sgyu ma gsum gyi dpes chos thams cad bden stong du gsungs pa dang*/ bka' 'khor lo tha mar sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po rtag brtan ther zug gi bden grub yod par gsungs pa dang 'gal lo snyam pa'i dogs pa bkod nas/ de'i lan du bka' 'khor lo tha ma las de ltar bshad pa ni bdag lta bus sangasargyas ga la thob snyam du sems zhum pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa'i sems can dman pa gzhan la brnyas pa dang*/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i chos la sgro 'dogs dang*/ yang dag pa'i chos la skur ba 'debs pa dang*/ bdag nyid la lhag par chags pa'i nga rgyal gyi skyon dang lnga spangs pa'i don du gsung bar bshad pas/ de'i shugs la sher mdo nges don yin pa gzhir bzhag dang*/ bka' tha ma drang don yin pa gsal por bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dir bdag nyid bla ma mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs klu sgrub rje'i gsung las/ dogs pa de'i lan ni/ de ltar ma yin te/ rgyud bla'i dgongs pa sher phyin gyi mdo'i don sprin gyi dpes bstan pa (43) nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs pa/ rmi lam gyi dpes bstan pa las kyi nyon mongs pa/ sgyu ma'i dpes bstan pa rnam smin gyi phung po dang gsum bden par med pa la dgongs par bshad nas yang dag mtha' chos dbyings sam/ bde gshegs snying po ni bka' tha ma las bshad pa bzhin bden par grub pa don la gnas so// zhes lan btab pa'i phyir te/

rgyud bla'i lung drang ma thag pa de'i 'phros las/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyi// rnam pa thams cad dben pa ste// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don// sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod// nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yin// las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin// nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin// phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhes bzhed do// de la gzu bo'i blos dpyad na/ snga phyi gnyis kar gzhung nyid la brten pa'i 'then tshul re 'dug mod/ 'on kyang phyogs phyi ma la dgos pa skyon lnga spangs pa'i don du gsung ba la go don 'chad rgyu ye med de/ bka' tha ma las de ltar gsungs pa nges don yin na/ dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa yin zhes dgongs pa gzhan du bkral mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gal te nges don dgos pa can yin no zhe na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ nges don dgongs pa can gyi tha snyad bshad pa med cing*/ 'dir bshad pa'i dgos pa skyon lnga spang ba ni dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla'i dgos pa skyon lnga spang ba dang*/ rab dbye las/ dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs// zhes pa'i dgos pa gnyis don gcig pa gang zhig (44) rab dbye'i de dgongs gzhi sogs gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i dgos pa yin pa la bsnyon 'ding rgyu med pa'i phyir/ gal te rgyud bla sems tsam dang*/ rab dbye dbu ma'i skabs yin pas mi 'dra'o snyam na/ byis pa dga' ba'i skyon spong ste/ rab dbyer dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa kha bskang ba ma gtogs gzhung phan tshun gyi dgos pa gnyis la khyad par phye na ha cang thal ba'i phyir/ gzhan du na rgyud bla'i skabs 'chad pa na dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa'i nges don gyi mdo khas len dgos pas/ mkhas pa'i mdun sar he he/ rgyu mtshan des na/ drang nges kyi mdo sde ma 'dres pa so sor shes dgos te/

dbu ma par khas 'ches na sher mdo nges don gyi mdo dang*/ bka' tha ma drang nges sna tshogs pa'i mdo yin par smra dgos so// bzhi pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs par mi 'thad pa ni/ chos dbyings gnyis med ces sogs go sla/ gsum pa dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bdag ni dpal ldan dus 'khor sogs so// gsum pa gnad don bsdus te bstan pa ni/ gzhi'i gnad mdor bsdu na/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad sems su 'dus shing*/ sems nyid gdod ma nas mtha' bzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i ngo bo stong pa nyid yin la/ stong nyid de dang gsal cha ya ma bral ba'i zung 'jug blo 'das brjod bral la rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying por shes par bya ste/ zung 'jug de ni gzhi dus kyi gnas lugs mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum las gzhi'i skabs kyi rnam par bshad pa bstan zin to// //'gro sems rang bzhin gtsang ma'i chos kyi dbyings// gzhi dus snying por ngos 'dzin shing rta'i srol// rnam gnyis (45) chu rgyun dbu ma'i rgya mtsho cher// dgongs dbyings gnad gcig kun mkhyen bla mar bzhed// rang rang blo mtshor sna tshogs grub pa'i mtha'// mun pa'i bag chags sra yang dpyad bzod kyi// lung rigs ri bong can shar dpyod ldan gyi// ku mud rdzogs ldan gsar pas sa gsum dge /bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do// //bcas rang nyes pa'i dri ma kun dag byed// bstan rtsa legs gsung so thar lam gsum rgyun// 'gro blo'i rgya mtshor 'bebs mkhas bha gi ra// kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras la spyi bos 'dud// gnyis pa lam gyi skabs la gnyis te/ lam gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ sdom pa gsum gyi lam so sor bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi 'dod tshul/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'dod tshul lo// dang po ni/ gzhi'i steng gi dri ma sbyong ba'i lam la/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po rang rang gi gzhung las/

theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi rnam gzhag bstan par bzhed de/ 'dul ba lung las/ kha cig ni nyan thos su sems bskyed do// kha cig ni rang rgyal du sems bskyed do// kha cig ni sangs rgyas su sems bskyed do// zhes sems bskyed tshul gsum gsungs pa dang*/ mdzod las/ myur ba srid pa gsum gyis thar// zhes dang*/ bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus// zhes dang*/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung*// dang po shākya thub pa yin// zhes sogs/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ theg chen gyi lam bgrod gsum gsungs pa rnams ni/ (46) bye smra dang*/ mngon pa smra ba'i mdo sde pa rnams kyi lugs dang*/ sa dngos gzhi las/ nyan sa rang sa byang sa gsum du gsungs pa ni sems tsam pa'i lugs dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*// 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes rtogs rigs kyi sgo nas theg pa gsum gyi lam gsungs pa ni dbu ma'i lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang grub mtha' 'og ma 'og ma las/ gong ma gong mar gtso che bas dbu ma pas gzhal na/ dbu ma'i gzhung ma gtogs gzhung gzhan las/ byang chub gsum po gang rung thob byed kyi theg pa gsum gyi lam tshang bar bstan pa med pa yin te/ dbu ma'i gzhung las bshad pa'i lta ba dang grub mtha' la ma brten pa theg pa gsum po gang gis kyang byang chub thob par mi nus pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa las thabs ma rmongs pa dang*/ thabs mang ba sogs khyad chos bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sngags lam du zhugs pa'i tshe rten gyi gang zag sdom pa gsum dang ldan pas/ thabs rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len la 'bad na 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub par nus pa yin te/ rab dbye las/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yis// rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na// de ni tshe 'di bar do 'am// skye ba bcu drug tshun chad na// 'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs// zhes gsungs pas so// sdom pa gsum po de yang*/

len byed kyi thabs 'dul ba dang*/ dbu sems dang*/ sngags kyi dbang chog las rim bzhin du blangs pa'i rim (47) 'jug pa'am/ sngar sdom pa 'og ma gnyis kyi sbyang ba ma song ba la/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga dkyus thog gcig las sdom pa gsum char thob pa'i cig char ba yin yang rung*/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i tshe na/ gsum ldan gyi rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum char yang sngags sdom gyi ngo bor yod pas ngo bo gcig yin no// 'o na ngo bo gcig yin na skye 'jig cig char du byed par 'gyur la/ de ltar na gtong thob dus gcig par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ phyi ma ma nges te/ skye 'jig ni skad cig gi skye 'jig yin la/ gtong thob ni rgyun la 'jog pa lung dang rigs pa'i gnad yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la gsum ste/ so thar sdom pa'i skabs/ byang sems sdom pa'i skabs/ rig 'dzin sdom pa'i skabs so// dang po la gnyis te/ nor pa'i mtha' bkag ma nor pa'i gnad bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo la log rtog dgag pa/ cho ga la log rtog dgag pa'o// dang po la nyan thos pa'i lugs nges don du 'dzin pa dgag pa sogs bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dga' gdong pa sogs mkhas pa kha cig so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can yin pa sogs bzhed cing*/ de'i 'khrul gzhi yang*/ bye smra'i 'dul mdzod rang rkang gi grub mtha' la a 'thas pas de la brten pa yin no// lugs de ni theg pa chen po'i skabs 'dir mi 'thad de/ bye smras sdom pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa yang mngon pa smra ba'i mdo sde pa rnams kyis bkag nas/ shes par bsgrub pa'i rtsod pa dang*/ rtsod lan rgyas pa mdzod kyi 'grel (48) pa sogs las gsungs na/ dbu sems dang sngags kyi gzhung 'chad pa'i tshe/ sdom pa gzugs can du mi 'thad pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na rgyud 'bum pa las/ rigs can gsum gyi bslab pa yang*// dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na// rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya 'o// zhes pa'i lung gis gnod de/

khyed ltar na theg dman sor sdom sngags sdom du gnas gyur pa'i tshe/ bem po shes par gnas gyur par khas len dgos la/ de ni lus sems rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa'i mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i lugs yin gyi/ sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung las bshad pa gtan mi srid pa'i phyir/ sor sdom la grangs rigs brgyad kho nar nges pa yang mi 'thad de/ 'o na nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo dang*/ byang sems so sor thar pa bstan pa'i mdo dang*/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo rnams las gsungs pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa rnams chos can/ rigs brgyad po gang du 'dod pa'am/ 'dus tshul smra dgos te/ so thar sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir/ byang sems so sor thar pa ni// chos dang bstan pa'i mod rnams las// zhes pa ni gzhung ma dag pas/ byang sems so sor thar pa dang*// chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo rnams las// zhes pa gzhung bris ma rnying pa 'ga' zhig las 'byung ngo*// zhes kho bo'i yongs 'dzin dam pas gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ sngags sdom dang byang sems kyi sdom pa gnyis po rigs brgyad gang du 'dus tshul yang smra dgos te/ de gnyis sor sdom yin pa'i phyir te/ sngags sdom la byang sdom gyis khyab/ byang sdom la (49) sor sdom gyis khyab pa ni mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa phul du phyin pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi grub mtha' rma med pa yin no// 'on kyang dbang bskur gyi cho ga las thob pa'i sngags sdom dang rigs brgyad gang rung gi gzhi mthun tsam ni yod de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ khyim pa'i sdom la legs gnas nas// zhes bshad pa'i khyim pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa las thob pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yin par bla ma ngor pa yab sras rnams bzhed pa'i phyir/ 'di la shes byed kyi 'thad pa yang mang du yod de/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ srog gcod rku dang 'khrig pa dang*// rdzun dang chang ni rnam spangs te// khyim pa'i sdom la legs gnas nas// zhes spang bya lnga spong du gsungs pa dang*/ sdom pa bsgrag pa na yang*/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya// ma byin pa yang mi blang ngo*// rdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams// dngos grub 'dod par bya ba min// chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// zhes spang bya lnga spong bsgrags pa de/ gsol btab kyi tshe/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// zhes pa dang don gnad gcig cho ga las gzung ba'i tshe/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i skabs su bzung ba'am thob pa yin pas so// rigs pa'i 'thad pa yang yod de/ 'di ni skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas pa'i sgo nas spang bya lnga spong (50) bar don gyis khas blangs pa'i sdom pa yin pas yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom par grub pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na gong du bshad pa'i nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo sogs nas gsungs pa dang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sor sdom rnams byang chub bar du blangs pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir na/ so thar gyi sdom pa yin na/ shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong bas khyab pa yang mi 'thad do// gnyis pa so thar la nges 'byung gis ma khyab pa dgag pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan la sogs pa las/ so thar sdom pa la 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims sogs gsum du dbye bar 'dod de/ dus kyi kun slong skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas la mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam gyi ston pa dang*/ chos la lam dngos dang*/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i zla grogs zhus te skyabs su song bas myang 'das kyi bsam pas zin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rgyu'i kun slong gi sgo nas 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims sogs gsum du dbye ba yin te/ cho ga'i snga rol rgyu'i kun slong la/

tshe 'di'i 'tshe ba sogs kyi 'jigs pa las bsrung ba dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ 'khor ba spang ba'i thar pa thob par 'dod pa dang gsum yod pas/ de'i dbang gis tshul khrims gsum du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes zer ro// de ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na phyi rol ba rnams kyi rgyud la yang so thar sdom pa yod par 'gyur te/ de'i rgyud la 'jigs skyob dang legs smon gyi tshul (51) khrims yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa song*/ 'dod mi nus te/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ ci phyi rol pa rnams la yang dag par blangs pa'i tshul khrims med dam zhe na/ yod mod kyi srid pa la brten pa'i phyir/ gtan du sdig pa las so sor thar par byed pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te so thar la 'jigs skyob dang legs smon yod par khas blang gi 'jigs skyob dang legs smon gyi tshul khrims la so thar gyis khyab pa khas mi len no snyam na/ gang ltar yang tshul khrims de gnyis chos can/ khyod du gyur pa'i sor sdom yod pa ma yin te/ srid pa 'khor ba la brten pa'i thob byar dmigs pa'i tshul khrims yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa mdzod 'grel gyi lung gis grub/ 'o na phyi rol pa'i rgyud kyi tshul khrims de yang*/ khong rang gi lugs kyi thar pa thob 'dod kyi bsam pas zin pas srid pa la ji ltar dmigs zhe na/ dmigs te/ kho rang gi lugs kyi thar pa nam mkha' na gdugs phub pa lta bu sogs la dmigs mod/ de dag gi thar par ming btags kyang 'khor ba las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ srid pa la brten pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don la rang phyogs pa kha cig 'khor ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir na so thar min zhes 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ so thar gyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pas/ mthar thug myang 'das kyi rgyu byed kyang gnas skabs su lha mi'i lus rten phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir te/ 'dul ba tshig le las/
lha yi

(52) khang bzang dam par skye// ting nge 'dzin dang nges 'byung thob// tshul khrims 'di ni 'bras bu che// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig phyi rol pa'i rgyud la sor sdom yod par bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ drangs ma thag pa'i mdzod 'grel gyi lung de dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ rab dbye las/ mu stegs byed la sdom pa med// ces bshad pa'i don yang*/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud la sor sdom med pa la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i phyi rol pa yod par 'gyur te/ khas blangs de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ grub mtha' la zhugs pa'i gang zag gis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ma song la phyi nang gi khyad par du 'jog pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro// gzu bo'i blos dpyod cig des na nges 'byung gi tshul khrims dang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa don gcig pa ni 'dul ba'i lugs yin te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes dang*/ sum brgya pa las/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di la kha cig zag med kyi sdom pa chos can/ sor sdom yin par thal/ nges 'byung gi tshul khrims yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i skyon gtong ba yod kyang*/ theg pa chen po ltar na 'dod la/ bye smra'i lugs ltar na gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ zag med kyi sdom pa ni/ zag med kyi snyoms 'jug sgom stobs kyis thob pa tsam (53) yin pas/ kun slong nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin ma zin gyi tha snyad med pa'i phyir/ de skad du mdzod las/ bsam gtan las skyes bsam gtan gyi// sa nyid kyis thob zag med ni// 'phags des zhes gsungs pas so// gal te skyabs 'gro'i sogs go sla// gzhung par mar/ rgyu yi kun slong myang 'das kyi// zhes dang*/ dus kyi kun slong sgo nas ni// zhes pa ni ma dag la/ phyogs snga'i bzhed pa dang bstun/

dus kyi kun slong myang 'das kyi// zhes sogs go brjes na dag pa yin te/ bris ma 'ga' zhig las kyang 'byung zhing*/ yongs 'dzin klu sgrub rje'i gsung las kyang de ltar bshad snang ngo*// paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can gyis so thar sdom pa'i rgyu'i kun slong 'jigs skyob kyi bsam pa sogs gsum phye nas/ dus kyi kun slong myang 'das kyi bsam pa kho nar bzhed pa ni/ mdzod dang yang 'gal te/ mdzod las/ rab tu 'jug byed dge sogs las// rjes 'jug byed kyang rnam gsum 'gyur// zhes rgyu'i kun slong dge ba la/ dus kyi kun slong dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum dang*/ rgyu'i kun slong mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan la yang*/ dus kyi kun slong de ltar gsum gsum bshad pa'i gsum tshan dang po ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa'i rgyu'i kun slong nges 'byung gi bsam pa yin pa gzhir bzhag nas/ dus kyi kun slong cho ga'i tshe nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gang rung gi bsam pa mngon gyur ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi bsam pa mngon (54) gyur ba dang gsum 'byung ba yod par 'grel ba sogs las gsal ba'i phyir/ dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang gi bsam pa mngon gyur du byung ba'i tshe yang*/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa bag la nyal ba'i tshul gyis yod de/ sngar rgyu dus kyi kun slong myang 'das kyi bsam pas zin pas/ bsam pa de'i rgyu mtshan de dus kyi kun slong la yang yod pa'i phyir ro// des na so thar sdom pa yin na/ rgyu'i kun slong myang 'das kyi bsam pa kho nas zin pas khyab/ dus kyi kun slong myang 'das kyi bsam pas zin pas khyab kyang*/ myang 'das kyi bsam pa kho nas ma khyab ces kho bo smra'o// gsum pa so thar gyi ngo bo la log rtog dgag pa ni/ shākya mchog ldan sogs kha cig gi bzhed pa yin zhing*/ so thar sogs phyogs snga brjod pa'i skabs go sla/ 'phags yul gyi gzhung 'grel las bshad pa med ces pa ni mi 'thad de/

dpal ldan kha che blo brtan gyi phung po lnga'i rab byed kyi 'grel pa bye brag tu bshad pa zhes bya ba las/ de la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni gzhan la gnod pa byed pa gzhi dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du ldog pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ lus dang srog gis bsdus pa'i dngos po la mi lta bar lus dang*/ ngag dang sems kyis rnam pa thams cad du gzhan la phan 'dogs par zhugs pa'o// zhes gsung zhing*/ de ltar gsungs pa de nyid rje btsun gong ma la sogs pa'i mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis kyang spyi bo'i thod bzhin du lung tshad mar 'khur bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro// (55) bzhi pa spyi'i ngo bo bye brag la sbyar ba dgag pa ni/ phyogs snga smra ba po kun mkhyen nam bsod sogs yin zhing*/ la la gzhan gnod sogs 'dod pa brjod pa go sla/ de dgag pa ni/ nged kyi lugs gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba so thar spyi'i ngo bor 'jog pa 'di ni lung gis grub ste/ blo brtan gyi lung gong du drangs zin pa dang*/ rje btsun gong ma'i sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa las/ so thar gyi sdom pa ni gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las bzlog pa yin la/ de'i steng du gzhan la phan 'dogs par 'dod cing zhugs pa ni byang chub sesam dpa'i sdom pa'o// de'i steng du rig pa 'dzin pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin no// zhes dang*/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong las kyang de dang cha 'dra bar gsungs pa dang*/ dpang lo dang mchims la sogs pas kyang tshul de ltar du gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyed kyi lugs gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba dge slong gi sdom pa kho na'i ngo bor 'jog pa ni mi 'thad de/ khyed rang gis rang dgar bzhag pa ma gtogs shes byed kyi lung khungs mi snang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa cho ga la log rtog dgag pa la/ sgrub byed kyi tshogs la 'khrul pa dgag bsgrub bya'i grangs la 'khrul pa dgag pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/

nam bsod sogs 'ga' zhig dge slong pha'i tshogs kho nas bsgrub bya bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i lag len byed pa thos so// de ni mi 'thad de/ tshogs gnyis phan tshun bsnor ba'am go brjes pa'i don pha'i tshogs kyis ma (56) chog dang*/ ma'i tshogs kyis pha chog byas pas kyang bsgrub bya la las chags pa dang*/ las tshig phan tshun bsnor ba ste pha chog la brten nas bud med dang*/ ma chog la brten nas skyes pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa na yang las chags par gsungs mod/ 'on kyang cho ga'i sgo nas bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa la tshangs spyod la nyer gnas sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/ de ni dge slong ma'i tshogs kho nas ster mod/ rtsa 'grel las bshad pa'i phyir/ gsung tshul de dag kyang rim bzhin yod de/ las bzhi'i thad kyi mdo rtsa las/ dge slong dang dge slong ma nyid dag gis gzhan byed pas ni mi chags pa min no// zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong phas ma chog dang*/ mas pha chog byas pas bsgrub bya la las chags par bstan/ 'dul ba lung las/ btsun pa dge slong gi las kyis dge slong ma bsnyen par rdzogs na/ bsnyen par rdzogs zhes bgyi'am/ ma rdzogs zhes bgyi/ utpa li rdzogs pa zhes bya ste rdzogs par byed pa la 'das pa dang bcas par ro// zhes gsungs pas/ pha chog la brten nas bud med la bsnyen rdzogs kyi las chags par bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo rtsa las/ tshangs par spyod pa la nye bar gnas pa'i sdom pa ma thob par bsnyen par rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro// gsang ste ston pa'i 'og tu dge 'dun gyi de sbyin par bya'o// zhes dang*/ de'i rgya cher 'grel las skabs yin pa'i phyir dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi zhes smos so// zhes gsungs pas/ bud med (57) bsnyen par rdzogs pa la tshangs spyod la nyer gnas sngon du 'gro dgos pa dang*/ de yang dge slong ma'i tshogs kho nas ster dgos par bstan pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di la spyir btang dmigs bsal yang ma gsungs shing sngon du 'gro mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed gzhan yang med pas na/

dge slong ma'i sde med pa'i yul phyogs su bud med bsnyen rdzogs kyi cho ga byed pa ni bstan pa dkrug par zad do// kha cig skyon spong bar 'dod nas skye la/ nyes byas la rung ste/ tshigs snga ma med pa nyid la ni nyes byas tsam du zad do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro// mi 'thad de/ tshangs spyod la nyer gnas bslab tshigs yin na de ltar bden yang*/ bud med la skyes pa la gsum yod pa de'i steng du lhag po dge slob ma las gzhan med pa'i phyir te/ mdo rtsa las/ bud med la ni dge slob ma zhes bya ba'i tshigs gzhan yod do// zhes gsungs pa'i rnam bcad las/ dge slob ma las lhag pa'i bslab tshigs lhag pho gzhan yod pa bkag pa'i phyir/ tshangs spyod la nyer gnas la bslab tshigs kyi don yang mi gnas te/ bslab tshigs mtshan nyid pa rnams la ni/ bslab pa snga ma de thob nas phyi ma ma thob pa'i bar der bslab bya'i grangs lhag po re la slob rgyu yod la/ tshangs spyod nyer gnas dang dge slong ma'i bar du ni bslab mtshams grangs lhag po la slob rgyu med pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na khyod las lhag pa'i skyes chen mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ (58) bar du dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes su/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa la bka' drin che ba bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ mkhan bu dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dus tha mar paṇa chen shākya shrī/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa la sogs pas kyang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bud med bsnyen rdzogs kyi phyag len ma mdzad pa 'di nyid la bsams nas bstan pa ma dkrug cig ces gdams te/ bshad pa dang lag len gang byed kyang mkhas grub gong ma dang mthun na bstan pa rnam dag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dir mkhas pa kha cig dpyad dgos pa'i dogs pa 'di gsungs te/ ma chog gi sgo nas bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa la/ tshangs spyod la nyer gnas sngon du 'gro dgos pa la gzhung gi don yin yang spyir de ltar mi dgos te/

pha chog gi sgo nas bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ pha chog gi sgo nas skyes pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong pha mar mtshan gyur pa'i dge slong ma de yang tshangs spyod la nyer gnas sngon song ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i dogs pa slong bar mdzad do// kho bo ni 'di ltar sems te/ pha chog gi sgo nas bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa de la yang tshangs spyod la nyer gnas sngon du 'gro dgos te/ dngos gzhi so so'i las skyes pa'i tshogs kho nas byed pa'i tshe yang tshangs spyod la nyer gnas kyi cho ga bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga'i cha lag yin pas sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na sbyor ba'i cho ga cha ma tshang bas dngos gzhir dge slong ma'i sdom pa (59) skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ dogs pa gnyis pa'i lan ni/ dge slong pha mar mtshan gyur pa'i dge slong ma'i rgyud kyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa de dge slong pha'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbyig gnyen gyi bshad pa de rang bzhin thugs dran sos na de kas chog go /gnyis pa bsgrub bya'i grangs la 'khrul pa dgag pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ la la bsnyen rdzogs sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ phyogs snga ma ni/ paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can no// gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi gsol bzhi'i las byed pa'i skabs ma gtogs yongs su dag pa dang*/ gsol ba mngon gyur dang mkhan po mngon gyur sogs cho ga'i skabs gzhan la yang*/ bsgrub bya gsum las mang ba 'jug tu rung bar 'gyur te/ cho ga'i skabs gzhan la las brgya rtsa gcig med pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rigs pa'am rgyu mtshan kun tu mtshungs pas so// spyir 'dul bar gsungs pa'i las la brgya rtsa gcig tu nges pa ni med de/ dge 'dun la rab byung zhu ba sogs kyang las su gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bsgrub bya gsum las mang ba la rab byung byed pa'i lag len 'di ni/
